slides.headline: She leads Teach For India's US arm. In 2026, a new award named her its first-ever winner.
Neha Gupta won the inaugural Deepak Raj Rising Star Award
slides.body: The award, created by the India Philanthropy Alliance in memory of philanthropist Deepak Raj, honors an emerging Indian-American leader under 40 with sustained commitment to philanthropy and community development. It was announced September 17, 2026, and Gupta delivered the closing keynote at the Indiaspora-India Philanthropy Alliance Philanthropy Summit in Dallas on September 29.

slides.headline: She has led Teach For India US since September 2024, after 15+ years across education, tech and finance.
slides.body: The award carries a $10,000 grant - which Gupta is directing straight back into Teach For India US, rather than keeping it as personal recognition.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat needs leaders who turn recognition back into the work.
slides.body: Gupta's choice to redirect the award's grant into her own organization's mission is a small, concrete example of diaspora leadership built on follow-through, not just titles.
